clauses.title: Scope – Lays down
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Lays down dimensions and tolerances for wrought aluminium alloys in the  form of wire.

clauses.title: Dimensions – The diameters
clauses.text: 2. Dimensions -  The diameters of round wires and the width/width across flats of shaped wires shall be as follows: mm mm mm 0.32 1.00 3.15 0.36 1.12 3.55 0.40 1.25 4.00 0.45 1.40 4.50 0.50 1.60 5.00 0.56 1.80 5.60 0.63 2.00 6.30 0.71 2.24 7.10 0.80 2.50 8.00 0.90 2.80 9.00

clauses.title: Round Wires
clauses.text: 3.1 Round Wires Diameter, mm Tolerance, mm Up to 0.63 ±  0.015 From 0.71 to 1.12 ±  0.025 From 1.25 to 9.0 ±  0.05 or  1 per cent of diameter which ever is higher. For detailed information, refer to IS 2525 : 1982 Specifications for wrought aluminium and aluminium alloy, wire (first revision).

clauses.title: Hexagonal and Octagonal Wires
clauses.text: 3.2 Hexagonal and Octagonal Wires Width Across Flats, Tolerance mm mm Up to 1.12 ±  0.04 Over  1.12 to 9.00 ±  0.07 or 1.5 percent of width across flats which ever is higher.

clauses.title: Square and Rectangular Wires
clauses.text: 3.3 Square and Rectangular Wires Width or Thickness Tolerance mm mm up to 2.50 ±  0.05 From 0.71 to 1.12 ±  0.08 From 1.25 to 9.0 ±  0.10 or  2 percent of width / thickness which ever is higher.
